description: This file declares functions and includes related to the electronic throttle control system in an engine management software project. It provides function prototypes for initializing, configuring, and managing electronic throttle body (ETB) parameters.

methods.name: setDefaultEtbBiasCurve
methods.description: Sets the default bias curve for the electronic throttle body.

methods.name: setDefaultEtbParameters
methods.description: Sets the default parameters for the electronic throttle system.

methods.name: setEtbPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for the ETB control.

methods.name: setEtbIFactor
methods.description: Sets the integral factor for the ETB control.

methods.name: setEtbDFactor
methods.description: Sets the derivative factor for the ETB control.

methods.name: setEtbOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset value for the ETB.

methods.name: isETBRestartNeeded
methods.description: Checks if restart of the electronic throttle system is needed.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeElectronicThrottleCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when electronic throttle configuration changes.
